title: Bihar ITI CAT 2026 2nd Round Allotment Result – Out
organization: Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board
vacancyDetails: 2nd Round seat allotment for Industrial Training Institute Competitive Admission Test against ~33,108 ITI seats
qualification: Matric / 10th pass with eligibility as per ITICAT 2026 prospectus
applicationFee: Counselling / admission fee as per board
selectionProcess: ITICAT Exam → Rank → Counselling Choice Filling → Seat Allotment Rounds → Reporting
documentsRequired: Allotment letter, rank card, 10th certificate, caste certificate, photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://bceceboard.bihar.gov.in
2. Open Second Round Seat Allotment Result of ITICAT-2026
3. Login and check allotment status
4. Download allotment letter and opening/closing rank PDF
5. Report to allotted ITI within schedule
shortDescription: BCECEB released Bihar ITI CAT (ITICAT) 2026 2nd Round Allotment Result on 18 July 2026 for 33,108 ITI seats. Check bceceboard.bihar.gov.in.
content:
BCECEB has released the Second Round Seat Allotment Result for ITICAT-2026 (Industrial Training Institute Competitive Admission Test) on 18 July 2026.

Allotment covers seats in government and private ITIs in Bihar. Also download Second Round Opening and Closing Rank PDF from the board website.

Candidates allotted seats must complete admission formalities on time or risk cancellation.
